item.title: I missed Bojangles when I left North Carolina. I’m glad it’s returning to Ocala.
item.description: "After leaving Charlotte, North Carolina, and moving back home to Florida, I knew I was gonna miss Bojangles. When I found that there was one not too far from where I moved to, I was excited. I was heartbroken when I heard it was closing. With no idea if it was going to reopen or not. Now, hearing that its coming back, I will be there! Thank you so much." - A Marion County resident shares an opinion. Read more: I missed Bojangles when I left North Carolina. I’m glad it’s returning to Ocala.

item.title: We are snowbirds who love Ocala and would love a bigger airport.
item.description: "My husband and I are snowbirds for the last five years after retiring. We love the area due to the convenience of having easy access to restaurants, shopping, etc. Yes, we see more traffic, but to me, it is a good sign of building a better economy. Our only drawback is the matter of Ocala not having an airport. We hear so many complaints. You would think with the expanding World Equestrian Center, the city would make that a priority as to accommodate the public. It would alleviate some traffic
